description: React component for an item selection dropdown with search functionality, utilizing hooks, external components, and styling.

methods.name: showDropdown
methods.description: Calculates dropdown height and makes it visible.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, triggers closeOnBlur hook.

methods.name: onSearchQueryChange
methods.description: Updates search query state on input change.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Shows dropdown when input gains focus.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Filters and sorts items based on search query.

methods.name: onSelectItem
methods.description: Handles item selection, calls onSelection callback.
